entries.en: The shorthand typist prepared a transcript of the interview.

entries.en: The research archive includes family histories concerning sickle-cell anaemia.
entries.zh: 研究档案中收录了有关镰状细胞贫血的家族病史。

entries.zh: 学校种下了一棵橡树，纪念建校二十五周年。

entries.en: The shopping list called for skimmed milk and plain yoghurt.

entries.en: A red skipping rope lay beside the playground bench.
entries.zh: 游乐场长凳旁放着一根红色跳绳。

entries.zh: 我把睡袋卷得足够紧，使它能放进背包。

entries.zh: 病例报告记载了发现一个安眠药瓶的情况。

entries.zh: 宾客到来前，我们得把礼堂整理得漂亮些。

entries.zh: 那封失踪的电子邮件最终成了调查中的确凿证据。

entries.en: The painting shows a snake charmer performing before a small crowd.
entries.zh: 画中是一位耍蛇人在一小群人面前表演。

entries.zh: 回忆录描写了长时间的单独监禁。

entries.zh: 来访者靠近时，她低声补充了一句警告。

entries.zh: 乐器制作师检查了共鸣板是否有细裂缝。

entries.zh: 他输掉比赛后的批评听起来像是酸葡萄心理。

entries.zh: 农场主剥开一个大豆荚，查看里面的豆子。

entries.zh: 训练结束后，拳击手向陪练道了谢。

entries.zh: 评论者把这套论证斥为无视相反证据的诡辩。

entries.zh: 体育记者在赛后采访了守门员。

entries.zh: 她对集邮的兴趣始于一盒旧信。

entries.zh: 旧市场是他周六早晨最喜欢去的熟悉地方。

entries.zh: 主席宣读了将每次发言限制在五分钟内的常设议事规则。

entries.zh: 观众向归来的指挥起立鼓掌。

entries.zh: 车站是我们徒步游览的起点。

entries.zh: 游客可以游览那座豪华古宅周围的花园。

entries.zh: 委员会投票决定，在审查完成前维持现状。

entries.en: Running the small theatre required imagination and considerable staying power.
entries.zh: 经营这家小剧院需要想象力和很强的持久力。

entries.en: He adjusted the steering wheel before moving the driver's seat forward.
entries.zh: 他先调整方向盘，再把驾驶座向前移。

entries.en: The temporary job became a stepping stone to a permanent position.
entries.zh: 那份临时工作成了获得长期职位的跳板。

entries.zh: 小说把内城区公寓与城市周边富人区的大宅作了对比。

entries.en: The tiny puzzle made an inexpensive stocking filler.
entries.zh: 那个小拼图成了一份不贵的圣诞袜礼物。

entries.zh: 她把一个迷你手电筒包好，作为圣诞袜小礼物。

entries.meaningZh: 城市生活中的机敏应对能力
entries.en: His street smarts helped him recognise the stranger's elaborate scam.
entries.zh: 他在城市生活中的机敏应对能力帮助他识破了陌生人的复杂骗局。

entries.zh: 小提琴是她学会演奏的第一件弦乐器。

entries.en: The workshop's strip lighting flickered before the power failed.
entries.zh: 停电前，车间的条形照明灯闪烁了。

entries.en: The exhibition traced the landscape changes caused by strip mining.
entries.zh: 展览记录了露天开采造成的地貌变化。

entries.meaningZh: 拘泥礼节而自命不凡的人
entries.en: The comedy portrays the mayor as a pompous stuffed shirt.
entries.zh: 喜剧把市长描绘成了一个拘泥礼节、自命不凡的人。

entries.en: The lack of reliable transport became a stumbling block for the project.
entries.zh: 缺少可靠的交通运输成了项目的障碍。

entries.en: The editor noted that the case was still sub judice.
entries.zh: 编辑指出，那起案件仍在审理中。

entries.en: The military display included an unloaded submachine gun behind glass.
entries.zh: 军事展览在玻璃后陈列了一支未装弹的冲锋枪。

entries.en: The teacher circled the subordinating conjunction that introduced the final clause.
entries.zh: 老师圈出了引出最后一个从句的从属连词。

entries.en: The critic described the composer's unusual style as sui generis.
entries.zh: 评论家把那位作曲家不同寻常的风格形容为自成一格。

entries.meaningZh: 假死；生命活动暂时停止

entries.zh: 那份旧医学报告把昏迷患者的状态描述为假死。

entries.en: The costume designer pinned a label to the vintage suspender belt.
entries.zh: 服装设计师给那条复古吊袜腰带别上了标签。

entries.en: The couple whispered sweet nothings while the orchestra played.
entries.zh: 管弦乐队演奏时，那对伴侣低声说着甜蜜情话。

entries.en: The old swimming bath reopened after its roof was repaired.
entries.zh: 屋顶修好后，旧室内游泳池重新开放了。

entries.en: She tucked her hair beneath a blue swimming cap.
entries.zh: 她把头发塞进了一顶蓝色泳帽。

entries.zh: 她的游泳衣上完早晨的课后还没干。

entries.zh: 修补瓷砖期间，游泳池是空的。

entries.en: He hung his swimming trunks over the balcony rail to dry.
entries.zh: 他把泳裤挂在阳台栏杆上晾干。

entries.en: We need to swot up on the river systems before tomorrow's geography test.
entries.zh: 明天地理测试前，我们得好好复习河流水系。

entries.zh: 系统分析师在提出软件修改建议前采访了用户。

entries.term: take the bull by the horns

entries.zh: 我们决定直面困难，讨论资金不知去向的问题。

entries.en: Among all their imaginative designs, this one seems to take the cake.
entries.zh: 在他们所有富有想象力的设计中，这一个似乎最为出众。

entries.zh: 代表等候主席准许自己发言。

entries.zh: 博物馆展示了一只曾用于盛放爽身粉的精美铁盒。

entries.meaningZh: 电视上对镜头讲话的人

entries.zh: 节目交替播放对镜头讲话的人物画面和工厂影像。

entries.en: The briefing sheet supplied a talking point about reduced waiting times.
entries.zh: 简报提供了一个关于缩短等候时间的论证要点。

entries.en: The rehearsal room echoed with tap dancing from the class upstairs.
entries.zh: 楼上班级跳踢踏舞的声音在排练室里回响。

entries.en: The tape recording preserved the old fisherman's account of the storm.
entries.zh: 磁带录音保存了老渔民对那场风暴的讲述。

entries.en: The grilled fish came with a small dish of tartare sauce.
entries.zh: 烤鱼配了一小碟塔塔酱。

entries.en: The child placed a teddy bear beside the hospital pillow.
entries.zh: 孩子把一只玩具熊放在医院的枕头旁。

entries.en: The golfer paused to tee up the ball before taking her stance.
entries.zh: 那位高尔夫球手先停下来把球放上球座，再摆好站姿。

entries.en: An old telegraph pole leaned over the narrow country lane.
entries.zh: 一根旧电话线杆倾斜在狭窄的乡间小路上方。

entries.en: I wrote the telephone number on the back of the envelope.

entries.zh: 风暴刮倒了农场旁的一根电话线杆。

entries.zh: 长焦镜头使摄影师能够把远处的帆船纳入画面。

entries.en: The team celebrated the end of term with an evening of tenpin bowling.
entries.zh: 团队晚上打十柱保龄球，庆祝学期结束。

entries.zh: 经过颠簸的航程，踏上陆地让我们松了一口气。

entries.zh: 海图标出了该国领海的边界。

entries.zh: 讽刺作品嘲笑了一位把普通人轻蔑地称为“群氓”的贵族。

entries.en: I was not the least bit surprised by the committee's decision.
entries.zh: 委员会的决定丝毫没有让我感到意外。

entries.en: We rarely see the likes of that enormous sailing ship in this harbour.
entries.zh: 我们在这个港口很少见到那样巨大的帆船。

entries.en: The repair team refused to throw in the towel despite another setback.
entries.zh: 尽管又遇到挫折，维修团队仍然拒绝放弃。

entries.en: I will be tied up with interviews until late afternoon.
entries.zh: 我会一直忙于面试，到下午晚些时候都不得空。

entries.zh: 教练要求每个队员在训练时都守规矩。

entries.en: The parenting workshop included a discussion of toilet training.
entries.zh: 育儿工作坊中有一场关于如厕训练的讨论。

entries.zh: 他把一片墨西哥玉米片蘸进番茄莎莎酱。

entries.zh: 提交费用报销申请前，请把收据金额加总。

entries.zh: 旅行推销员用一个磨旧的皮箱装着布料样品。

entries.zh: 封闭的地窖里藏着一批珍贵的旧银币。

entries.en: The trompe l'oeil made the flat wall resemble an open window.
entries.zh: 那幅错视画使平墙看起来像一扇敞开的窗户。

entries.zh: 钢琴调音师检查第一个音之前，先敲响了音叉。

entries.meaningZh: 后来出众、早年不被看好的人

entries.zh: 故事中那个早年不被看好的人后来成了自信的年轻表演者。

entries.en: The model shows the umbilical cord connecting the fetus with the placenta.
entries.zh: 模型展示了连接胎儿与胎盘的脐带。

entries.zh: 在这种情况下，推迟户外音乐会似乎是明智的。

entries.zh: 标签被上下颠倒地贴在木箱上。

entries.en: The vacuum cleaner struggled to pick up the larger wood shavings.
entries.zh: 吸尘器很难吸起较大的刨花。

entries.en: We packed a vacuum flask of hot soup for the cold journey.
entries.zh: 我们为寒冷的旅途带了一保温瓶热汤。

entries.zh: 画家画铁轨前，先标出了透视消失点。

entries.zh: 风险投资者考虑该项目之前，要求先看原型。

entries.zh: 法律讨论涉及对信托未来收益的一项既得权利。

entries.en: The ferry carries people from the island to the mainland and vice versa.
entries.zh: 渡船把人从岛上送到大陆，反方向也是如此。

entries.en: A wealthy visiting fireman paid for the club's annual dinner.
entries.zh: 一位富有的来访贵宾出钱办了俱乐部的年度晚宴。

entries.en: The children floated toy boats in the wading pool.
entries.zh: 孩子们在儿童浅水池中放玩具船。

entries.en: He rested his walking stick against the garden gate.
entries.zh: 他把手杖靠在了花园门上。

entries.zh: 洗衣机在最后一道漂洗进行到一半时停了。

entries.zh: 她用温室旁桶里的水装满了浇水壶。

entries.en: The committee made the junior clerk a whipping boy for its own mistakes.
entries.zh: 委员会让那位初级职员为它自己的错误充当了代罪羔羊。

entries.zh: 机械师在下雨前装上了新的挡风玻璃雨刷。

entries.zh: 工资单在员工工资总额下方列出了预扣所得税。

entries.zh: 还没人核实事实，她就为那个传言激动了起来。

entries.zh: 公司为旺季额外保留了可用的营运资本。

entries.zh: 小说以一个工厂城镇里的工人阶级家庭为中心。

entries.en: The anatomy tutor pointed to the abducent nerve on the enlarged chart.
entries.zh: 解剖学老师在放大的图上指出了展神经。

entries.en: The Latin exercise asks students to identify an ablative absolute.
entries.zh: 拉丁语练习要求学生找出一个独立夺格结构。

entries.en: The adventure novel sends its heroes in search of the abominable snowman.
entries.zh: 冒险小说让主人公们去寻找喜马拉雅雪人。

entries.en: The instrument recorded the absorption spectrum after light passed through the sample.
entries.zh: 光通过样本后，仪器记录了吸收光谱。

entries.en: The engineer marked the abutment arch on the bridge drawing.
entries.zh: 工程师在桥梁图纸上标出了支墩拱。

entries.en: The exhibition displayed photographs taken by a submersible in the abyssal zone.
entries.zh: 展览展示了潜水器在深海底带拍摄的照片。

entries.en: The driving instructor adjusted the seat before checking access to the accelerator pedal.
entries.zh: 驾驶教练先调整座位，再检查是否能够踩到加速踏板。

entries.en: The anatomy drawing marks the accessory cephalic vein along the forearm.
entries.zh: 解剖图标出了沿前臂走行的副头静脉。

entries.en: The atlas labels the accessory vertebral vein on a detailed neck diagram.
entries.zh: 图谱在详细的颈部示意图上标出了副椎静脉。

entries.en: The case study describes an accommodation endorser who received no payment.
entries.zh: 案例研究描述了一名没有收取报酬的通融背书人。

entries.en: The demonstration illustrated the accommodation reflex using a model of the eye.
entries.zh: 演示用眼球模型说明了调节反射。

entries.en: The drawing shows an accompanying vein running beside the artery.
entries.zh: 图中显示了一条沿动脉旁走行的伴行静脉。

entries.en: The auditors requested the accounting data behind the published statement.
entries.zh: 审计人员要求提供支撑已公布报表的会计数据。

entries.en: The accountant corrected an accounting entry for the equipment purchase.
entries.zh: 会计更正了一条购买设备的会计分录。

entries.en: A local accounting firm reviewed the charity's annual accounts.
entries.zh: 当地一家会计师事务所审查了慈善机构的年度账目。

entries.en: The training session examined the accounting principle used in the example.
entries.zh: 培训研究了示例中采用的会计原则。

entries.en: The report identifies the accounting standard applied to the transaction.
entries.zh: 报告指出了该笔交易所适用的会计准则。

entries.en: The ledger lists outstanding supplier invoices under accounts payable.
entries.zh: 分类账把尚未支付的供应商发票列在应付账款项下。

entries.en: The monthly report showed an increase in overdue accounts receivable.
entries.zh: 月报显示逾期应收账款增加了。

entries.en: The simulator displayed the accumulator register after each addition.
entries.zh: 模拟器在每次加法操作后显示累加寄存器的值。

entries.en: The grammar exercise puts the direct object in the accusative case.
entries.zh: 语法练习把直接宾语置于宾格。

entries.en: The labelled image shows an acentric chromosome beside the normal pair.
entries.zh: 标注图像展示了一条无着丝粒染色体，位于正常染色体对旁。

entries.en: The costume label identified the lining as acetate rayon.
entries.zh: 服装标签注明内衬为醋酸人造丝。

entries.en: The historical medical index contains several references to achylia gastrica.
entries.zh: 历史医学索引中有几条有关胃液缺乏的文献记录。

entries.en: The research review compared published studies of acne vulgaris.
entries.zh: 研究综述比较了已发表的寻常痤疮研究。

entries.en: She arranged slices of acorn squash on a roasting tray.
entries.zh: 她把小青南瓜的切片摆在了烤盘上。

entries.en: The clinical teaching notes distinguish acoustic aphasia from hearing loss.
entries.zh: 临床教学笔记把听觉性失语与听力损失区分开来。

entries.en: The sailors heard the acoustic buoy before they could see the harbour entrance.
entries.zh: 水手们尚未看见港口入口，就先听见了音响浮标的声音。

entries.en: The collector demonstrated an acoustic gramophone using an old shellac record.
entries.zh: 收藏者用一张旧虫胶唱片演示了喇叭式留声机。

entries.en: The display showed an acoustic modem beside an old telephone handset.
entries.zh: 展品中，一个声频调制解调器放在旧电话听筒旁。

entries.en: The engineering report plots acoustic reactance against frequency.
entries.zh: 工程报告绘制了声抗随频率变化的曲线。

entries.en: The biology lecture contrasts acquired immunity with innate immunity.
entries.zh: 生物学讲座把获得性免疫与先天性免疫作了对比。

entries.en: The diagram shows the unequal arms of an acrocentric chromosome.
entries.zh: 示意图展示了一条近端着丝粒染色体长短不等的两臂。

entries.en: The medical archive includes a photographed case of actinic dermatitis.
entries.zh: 医学档案中收录了一个附有照片的光化性皮炎病例。

entries.en: The dermatology atlas lists actinic keratosis in its index.
entries.zh: 皮肤病学图谱在索引中列出了光线性角化病。

entries.en: The laboratory log records the actinic radiation used in the experiment.
entries.zh: 实验记录记下了实验中使用的光化辐射。

entries.en: The apparatus diagram marks the path of an actinic ray towards the sample.
entries.zh: 装置示意图标出了光化射线射向样本的路径。

entries.en: The lecturer distinguished actus reus from criminal intent.
entries.zh: 讲师把犯罪行为与犯罪意图区分开来。

entries.en: The historical case collection contains a report describing acute gastritis.
entries.zh: 历史病例集中有一份描述急性胃炎的报告。
